task: Phase 2 R24 STAGE 2 - R24 routing codec table (grounded arcs only, full group depth + exact-match REJECT guard + contamination audit)
codec_code: reuses c4_codec.C4Codec VERBATIM, imported as R24Codec (r24_codec.py)
node_lattice: node(X,Y) = 59111 + 23*X + 1*Y  (fabric I0); edge X8 uses STAGE-1 real id
encoding_model: multi-level one-hot; arcs keyed by ABSOLUTE anchor-column select codeword
select_field_semantics: Each fabric R24 driver node's source-select is its last two device-file groups (level A large + level B 2-cell) at the anchor-column frame f_anchor(X). The other num_groups-2 groups are wire-body/tap groups (downstream-dependent) and are NOT part of any codeword. Full depth is recorded in group_sizes; only the select fields carry the source code.
groundable_source_classes: R4 (the physical driver-input class of every fabric R24 mux) + R24-cascade. This is the R24 analog of the C4 template's 'LE_BUFFER + same-class cascade': on EP4CE6 an LE reaches a long line only through an R4 (LE->R24 is never routed, verified), so R4 is the direct driver class. LE_BUFFER / C4 / C16 / LOCAL / IO are REJECT-ONLY (no arc).
codeword_semantics: Each arc's codeword is the set of CRAM cells hot in the mux's OWN select fields in a real specimen rbf. decode() forms the same set (restricted to the node's signature cells) and requires an EXACT match; no match -> None (undriven mux, unmodeled/other-class source, or partial pattern are all rejected, never guessed).
decontamination: Each node's select-field candidate cells are audited against every other bound node's full device-file inventory (its frame band); a cell also in another band is STRIPPED. R24 select fields sit at the per-column anchor frame with a per-row byte offset, so they are pairwise DISJOINT (0 stripped). Static ZERO cross-node signature overlap holds.
validation: HELD-OUT only (fresh SEED 3/6 + fresh rows 8/10/12); see validate_r24_heldout.py.
